name: minimum, version 1
why: the simplest case that is not all zeros, so a dead encoder fails it

name: unsigned fields at maximum, feature at its maximum positive value
why: catches a width error, and catches reading 131071 as eighteen set bits

name: every bit set
why: forty set bits decode to feature -1, which is a different case from the one above

name: negative feature, everything else ordinary
why: catches a missing sign extension, which is invisible for positive values

name: most negative feature
why: only the sign bit of the field is set, which catches an off-by-one in the width

name: sequence alone, at maximum
why: sequence straddles a byte boundary, so a one-bit misplacement cannot produce this
